# Upstream extension return defaults belong in explicit API expectations

Keep expected API result shapes explicit when upstream adds a supported default field. The scripting.registerContentScripts test added world:ISOLATED rather than dropping object comparison or masking the new field. Pair the expected-shape update with source/API compatibility reasoning; reviewer-reported pass is evidence but was not locally reproduced here.
